description_en:
Query the list of IoT data source groups.
Users can view IoT data source groups they have registered.
Administrators can view all IoT data source groups under the project
description_zh:
查询IoT数据源组列表
使用方可查看自己注册的IoT数据源组
管理方可查看项目下所有的IoT数据源组
name: ListDeviceGroup

parameters.help_en: Specifies the page number to display in the returned results. The minimum value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 指定显示返回结果中的第几页，最小取值1
parameters.name: num

parameters.help_en: Specifies the number of records displayed per page in the returned results. The maximum value is 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大值是100
parameters.name: size

parameters.help_en:
ProductKey of the IoT data source group.

If not specified, all IoT data source groups under the business chain are queried
parameters.help_zh:
IoT数据源组ProductKey。

不传则查询业务链下所有的IoT数据源组
parameters.name: product_key
